properties.description: Copies WWT Geo SCADA Objects from blob storage into Postgres table and maps JSON properties to columns in Postgres
Linked service for default Postgres DB where Geo SCADA Source configuration will be loaded.
Linked service to blob storage containing Geo SCADA SCXExport JSON files for ingest
Draft Dataflow: If Geo SCADA fullname starts with any of the Source site names, replace the old site name with the new rise site name

scriptLines:
query: 'SELECT *,
       CONCAT_WS('.',
           l1_catchment_or_region,
           l2_stw_catchment_or_hydraulic_system,
           l3_treatment_network_or_production,
           l4_site_name
       ) AS rise_sitename
FROM site_mapping
WHERE source_system = 'WWT'',
rise_fullname = concat(rise_sitename,'.', right(fullname, length(fullname) - length(source_site_fullname)-1))) ~> BuildRiseNames

activities.name: Delete GeoSCADA Rise Config from Postgres

source.query:
SELECT fullname, typename, properties, aggregates FROM rise_objects
ORDER BY fullname asc
